design_notes: Emotion stories are 20 one-sentence stories per emotion about a character named Alex, generated by claude-sonnet-4-6 with 10_generate_stimuli.py; each conveys the emotion only through physical sensations and internal thoughts, with no emotion word, in under 20 words. They are not topic-matched to the neutral baselines. Neutral baselines are 15 flat, factual stories across the listed topics. Neutral filler turns are unrelated topics, fixed and identical across all conditions, used to bridge measurement turns in the persistence/decay experiment.
